The mixed-store control is included in the proof plan. [DESIGN.md](/Users/lchingen/hivemind/docs/research/2026-11-14-use-acceptance/page-contract/DESIGN.md:21)

One wording correction for the record: **no table is a legacy compatibility rule, not proof of production provenance**. I found a stored clean unseeded draw with no `clean_ladders` table. Its existing two- and five-choice records should be included in the compatibility check alongside the production dataset. The planned proofs have not yet run.
